src/modules/notifications/lib/emails: HTML email templates — email clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail) do not support CSS custom properties; all style values must be literal inline styles
src/modules/notifications/lib/sendTempla: HTML email layout template using BRAND_ACCENT const and inline hex literals; CSS custom properties are unsupported in email HTML
src/app/api/auth-email-hook/route.ts: Supabase auth email hook — generates inline HTML email for email_change events; CSS custom properties are unsupported in email HTML
src/modules/auth/components/AuthSheet.ts: Official Google brand SVG fill colors (#4285F4/#34A853/#FBBC05/#EA4335) from Google Identity Guidelines — brand colors are fixed by Google policy and cannot be replaced with design tokens
src/components/ui/appImageConfig.ts: Next/Image sizes media-descriptor strings + inline SVG blur placeholder color — neither can reference CSS custom properties
src/components/shared/PerfDevOverlay.tsx: Dev-only performance diagnostic overlay — guarded by process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'development' (build-time constant); returns null and is tree-shaken from production bundles; z-[9999] and text-[10px] are non-production UI
